description: Mint an NFT after separately paying the mint fee (see prepare_payment or pay any other way, then wait for on-chain confirmation -- check_payment_status). Pin your asset (and a thumbnail, for video) to IPFS yourself first; this server never stores files. Each payment transaction hash can only be used once -- a failed mint attempt does not consume it, retry with the same payment_tx. You are solely responsible for the content referenced by ipfs_hash.
name: mint
